headline: Prime Minister orders accelerated enforcement measures to meet tax targets | Express News
summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif ordered accelerated enforcement measures to meet tax targets. He said the faceless system for Inland Revenue must be fully rolled out by 2027.
why: Tax collection targets underpin Pakistan's fiscal position and its commitments to international lenders, making revenue measures important for the economy and sovereign credit.
